options.name: access_key
options.description: Access key used to authenticate with the Minio server located at O(url).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the alias to be managed.

options.name: secret_key
options.description: Secret key used to authenticate with the Minio server located at O(url).

options.name: state
options.description: Indicates the desired alias state. V(present) ensures the alias is present. V(absent) ensures the alias is absent.

options.name: url
options.description: Minio server url to be associated with this alias.
